On Main Street

A casual room for conversation inside, and tables out on the sidewalk when the weather allows.

“This intimate bar and eatery is sure to impress.”

Matthew Wetzel, Google review

The name

Mambrino King was East Aurora's legendary trotting horse. The bar carries his name, and a trotter with a high-wheel sulky is painted on the wall above the espresso bar.

The Buffalo News told it as “the horse, the wine bar and the East Aurora legend.”

The gold trotter is drawn from Eadweard Muybridge's 1878 photographs of the trotter Abe Edgington.
